mvcc.pair_mean_policy: Only 2/2 available scores produce a pair mean. No added tests is explicit zero; unavailable is null.
mvcc.score_definition: Executed assertion failures against six fixed single-defect controls, after candidate and reference tests pass without skips. Errors and hangs are unavailable, not detections.

dag.runtime_definition: Each candidate: median of three archived samples. Setting: mean of the two candidate medians.
dag.memory_definition: Mean of two candidate tracemalloc peaks in KiB; Python allocations, not process RSS or native memory.

effort.cost_definition: Mean API-equivalent USD across all 12 attempts. Partial totals have null exact mean and an observed lower bound.
effort.quality_definition: Equal six-task macro average of paired main snapshot functional grades. Completed acceptance is separate.
effort.multiples_reference: The same model at Low effort.

repetition_cost.ratio_definition: More expensive repeat divided by cheaper repeat; two observations, not a confidence interval.

excluded_keys.reason: At least one archived API estimate is partial.
At least one archived API estimate is partial.

pricing_bridge.interpretation: Accounting counterfactual at frozen Standard API rates, not a causal experiment. Usage includes input, cache, output, and request-level long-context treatment.
